claim-expired.why: Claims age by design: DEMO-0003, DEMO-0014 and DEMO-0025 are the stale-claim examples, and waiting or testing tickets keep their claim while they wait. Run `seed.py refresh-claims --apply` before a live demo.

gate-invalidated.why: The 'changed' gate examples: DEMO-0018 requirements and DEMO-0025 plan were edited after approval; DEMO-0033's requirements were edited after the epic approval of DEMO-0031 (changed since epic approval).

task-doing-stale.why: DEMO-0025 is the stale-claim example: its T1 stays in progress after the claim expired, so Mission Control shows a stale doing task.

delegated-approval.why: DEMO-0036 is the child an agent added to DEMO-0031 and auto-approved under the epic's signed delegation; orch check lists every such approval as an info line.
